Needs changes before merge.

## What looks good

- The Work offset control now shows on the WCS page, in its own group. The Setup page does not draw it. This is what issue #1648 asked for.
- The control keeps its command `SetSetupWorkOffset`. The picker queues it through `state.pending`. Undo and redo do not change.
- The posted offset still comes from the setup's own slot (`setup::wcs_slot`). The change adds no second derivation.
- The MCP tool `set_work_offset` runs the same command (`crates/app/src/mcp/setup_tools.rs`). The GUI and the agent surface agree.
- The strings are plain English. The group title reads "Work offset (G54-G59)". The combo keeps the #931 wording.
- Structural tests pin both pages: `one_wcs.rs` (two tests, one new), `setup_settings_page.rs`, and `structural.rs`. No snapshot PNG changed.
- `docs/decisions/1648-wcs-page-work-offset.md` records the decision. The PR body is complete: what changed, tests, not-exercised, a `Changelog:` line, and the issue keyword.

## Results

Built on the self-hosted runner (macOS): https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43645794944

- Trial merge with main `4a0ba90f9f09150da1e3d252a5422503f0d44b5d`: clean.
- Quick gate: pass. The ui suites (incl. the `camcraft-ui --lib` tests with the new structural assertions) ran 54 s, 0 failed.
- Clippy on `camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not built locally: the diff adds no Windows-only readings, so the runner's macOS arms cover it.

## Requested before merge

1. Add the before and after screenshots to the PR body. This PR changes a UI page, so rule #1209 needs the pair in the description. The body states "no screenshot exists" in Not exercised. Show the WCS page and the Setup page before the change, and both pages after it. Flag the PR back to ready after the push, per the draft rule.
2. Restore LF line endings in the six changed source files. Main stores these files with LF. The PR head stores them with CRLF. The diff then shows about 2,600 changed lines where 63 lines carry the real change. `structural.rs` and `pages.rs` are files that other open PRs touch, so the flip raises conflict work for them. Convert the six files back to LF.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- The picker still draws its row label `"    Work offset"` with a leading indent (crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_wcs_pick.rs). The indent came from the Setup page rows. Inside its own titled group the label repeats the title. A later issue can drop it.
- `pages.rs` is about 1,230 lines and grew by 2 lines. Files already over the 400-line mark are a note, not a blocker.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
